decisionsTitle: A member's number: the race's background with its own header, and a member mark
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-13:** «și BIB-uri, trebuie încă o setare pentru membrii BVR, trebuie să aibă ceva bifă, nu doar background, cel mai probabil nu vor avea alt background, ci doar alt header și încă o bifă».

**Decision.** Amends §664 (the members' number) and §695 (its background); §735's format and the numbering are untouched.

- **The race's own background, a header of their own.** The members' background choice already had the means: «Top band only» is the ordinary number with the members' header and label, and nothing under it changes. It is now named for what the club wants — «Același fundal ca restul numerelor — doar antet propriu» ("Same background as the other numbers — own header only") — and its help says so in one line. No third style value: it would draw exactly what `band` draws. Every stored design reads as it did.
- **The member mark.** A new tick in the members' object, `member.mark`, «Semn de membru pe număr» («Member mark on the number»), off by default, so every stored design reads as today. On, every member's number — and only a member's, and only while the members' number is on — carries a ring with a check mark in it: on the PDF sheet (members' pile included), on the picture (the bibs page and the desk) and in the editor's preview. It sits at the card's left inset, 12 points under the header's foot, 26 points across with a 2.4-point stroke, in the number's own ink (white on the whole card, the body ink on white), never a colour literal. It is beside the number rather than over it: the number is centred and, even at five digits at the largest size, reaches about 44 points from the card's edge, 26 from the inset, so it clears the ring. The name is another matter: when «Numele» is set above the number its box runs inset to inset and is cut exactly at the inset, so a long name (a double Romanian name with a hyphenated surname, about 35 characters at 24 points) would print over the ring. While the mark is drawn, the name above the number therefore gives up the mark's width plus a 10-point gap on each side in both renderers (`bibNameReserve`, `BIB_LAYOUT.memberMarkGap`): it stays centred and is cut with an ellipsis at least 10 points clear of the ring. The name below the number is nowhere near the mark and keeps its whole box. The mark is drawn as vector strokes from one set of points (`MEMBER_MARK_CHECK`) by both renderers, so no font has to carry a glyph and the sheet and the picture cannot differ; it reads at A5 and at half of it. It is not the house's icon registry's glyph: pdfkit cannot draw the registry's React icons, and one set of points keeps sheet and picture identical; the same SVG path could be drawn by `doc.path()` and Satori if the registry's look is wanted.
- **The editor.** Everything the members' number decides sits under «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» through `OnlyWhenTicked` (hidden, still posted), the preview with it, and the mark's tick has its one-line «Bifat: … Debifat: …» help in both languages. The mark travels in the preview's address as `memberMark`, so the picture's address — and its cache — changes with it. The bibs page stamps the whole `event.design` (§748), so `member.mark` enters the bibs page's picture addresses; the desk's picture address stamps only the number's format, so a desk picture already loaded keeps showing a member's number without the mark for up to the cache hour after the tick changes.
- **No migration.** `events.bib_design` is a JSON column read through `readBibDesign`; a design without the key reads `mark: false`.

**Refused.** A mark in a font glyph (the sheet's fonts may not carry it, and the picture's would differ); a mark over the number; a separate switch for the picture and the sheet.
changelogLine: - **A member's number keeps the race's background and gets a mark** — «Același fundal ca restul numerelor» (own header only) is named in the editor, and the tick «Semn de membru pe număr» puts a check mark on every member's number, in the picture, the PDF sheet, the desk and the members' pile. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the members' number on with «Semn de membru pe număr» ticked, then every member's number — on the PDF sheet, the picture, the desk's picture and the members' pile — carries a ring with a check mark at the card's left inset under the header, in the number's own ink, drawn from one set of points by both renderers, and an ordinary number, a spare and any number while the members' number is off carry none; unticked, which every design stored before the key reads as, nothing is drawn (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). With «Numele» set above the number the name's box is narrowed on both sides by the mark's width plus a gap while the mark is drawn, in both renderers, so no letter prints over the ring.

A design saved before the member mark existed reads `member.mark` as false and the members' background as it was; the mark travels in the preview's address as `memberMark` and is read back by the same schema, so the picture's address changes when the tick does; the editor shows the members' fields, the mark's tick included, only while «Membrii primesc un număr cu design propriu» is ticked (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The members' band style is named «Același fundal ca restul numerelor — doar antet propriu» (the race's own background, the member's header and label only); criterion 70's quoted «Doar banda de sus» is superseded by it, and a design saved as `band` before reads as it (2026-10-13, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
